body.label: Effect
body.html: Establish a 2-unit Circle centered on a point within 4 units. It lasts until your next turn.

surges.html: Increase this Rite's Echo Limit by 1.
Increase one range, radius, or numeric Echo effect by 1.

rider.title: CIRCLE RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: An enemy enters or begins its turn inside the Circle. Echo: It suffers -1 Defense until it leaves the Circle or its turn ends.
